methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: we apply the approach to calculate EnPIs following the guidelines of the ISO 50005:23 and consider operational ratings according to Goldstein and Eley

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper proposes an approach comprised of an application layer that interacts with semantic technologies to calculate and analyze energy performance indicators

level_3b.evidence_quote: NEST is a modular research and innovation building in which new technologies, materials, and systems are tested under real-life conditions

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: primarily a semantic-web tool/software (application layer, KPI synchronization engine, dashboard), but it defines and applies simple intensity-ratio EnPIs (Table 2) per ISO 50006/50005, so charted eligible. 'Continuous' in title = continuous KPI calculation, not a continuous-process industry; application context is buildings (NEST demonstrator), so level_3b=false.
